frozen_note: written on 2026-10-21, before any historical NBA price was bought; the purchase is blocked in code until 2026-11-01
question: Does the v1.3 winner probability add information beyond the Pinnacle no-vig price? It never produces a bet, a stake or a pick.

market.source: The Odds API historical endpoint, region eu, bookmaker pinnacle, market h2h, one snapshot per Eastern game day taken 30 minutes before that day's earliest known tipoff (nba.odds_history plan)
market.price_rules: event must not have started at the snapshot; the book's update must not be after the snapshot nor more than 6 hours before it; both decimal prices finite and > 1; the snapshot must fall on the same Eastern calendar day as the game (snapshots also list later days, whose prices are a day old)
market.team_names: the provider's 'Los Angeles Clippers' is read as games.json 'LA Clippers'; every other name must match exactly (checked against the provider's 30 names)
market.not_closing_line: the price is taken before the first game of the day, so for later games it is hours old; minutes_to_tipoff is kept for every game and used to stratify

model.definition: v1.3 exactly as published (multimarket_v13), old injury reports, trained on the two scored seasons before each evaluated season with no data of the evaluated season; the live model and its reports are not changed

arms.aligned: PRIMARY. The model may use injury reports only up to min(tipoff - 60 min, snapshot time), so the model and the market know the same things; a game with no earlier report is treated as unobserved, as in v1.3
arms.tminus60: SECONDARY. The published rule (reports up to tipoff - 60 min). For games after the first of the day this is newer information than the price has, so it favours the model and is reported only to show that gap

coverage_rule: per season, matched games (a model probability and an accepted price) / games with a known tipoff must be >= 0.85, otherwise that season is reported as inconclusive and no decision is taken from it

metrics.differences: paired Brier difference with a 95% bootstrap that resamples whole dates (400 replicates, seed 20261101)
metrics.information_weight: c in logit(p) = logit(market) + c * (logit(model) - logit(market)), one parameter, no intercept, maximum likelihood; c = 0 is the market, c = 1 is the model; 95% interval by the same date bootstrap
metrics.walk_forward: c fitted on 2024-25 and applied unchanged to 2025-26; Brier of that blend against the market on 2025-26
metrics.blend_5050: equal logit blend of model and market, reported for reference

decision_rule.better_than_market: aligned arm: upper 95% bound of (model Brier - market Brier) < 0 in both seasons
decision_rule.adds_information: aligned arm: lower 95% bound of c > 0 in both seasons AND the walk-forward blend has a lower Brier than the market in 2025-26 (point estimate)
decision_rule.otherwise: no evidence that the NBA winner probability adds information over Pinnacle; it is not used as a pick. This is the expected outcome for an efficient market and is a valid result
decision_rule.scope: adds_information is necessary, not sufficient, for any commercial use: it says nothing about prices available to a customer, limits, or totals and team points

descriptive_only: bins of the gap model - market with observed home-win rate
sensitivity of every comparison to the power de-vig
not_modeled: totals and team points (second phase, December)
next_phase: if a prospective test is wanted, capture the current Pinnacle price at the moment each cohort is sealed (about 1 credit per day) and compare on sealed forecasts; this protocol is retrospective and exploratory
